# Vendored history

`crest/` is a `git subtree` of https://github.com/jaywedgeworth22/crest
(`8b4ca72` and ancestors). It is kept so Crest's commits are not rewritten
or discarded. BadgeBook is the product; do not run Crest as a second app.

Ported capabilities and the review-first contract are documented in
[docs/CREST-MERGE.md](../docs/CREST-MERGE.md).
